content.name: EOC - Executive Operations Center
content.description:
[h1]EOC - Executive Operations Center[/h1]
Transform your X4 empire from reactive management into intelligent operations. EOC continuously observes your stations, identifies recurring operational problems, and provides evidence-based recommendations while keeping you in control.
[h2]Important Startup Timing[/h2]
After loading or starting a game, EOC displays an initialization notice. [b]Wait approximately 10 seconds[/b] for the initial station scan to complete before opening EOC from the Personal Office Dock Interactions action. The completion summary confirms EOC is ready.
[h2]Key Features[/h2]
[list] [*][b]Lua Management Window[/b] - Native-style access to stations, executive intelligence, logistics, diagnostics, cases, reports, and global settings. [*][b]Executive Intelligence[/b] - Empire health, operational KPIs, trends, and stations requiring attention. [*][b]Economy, Production, Workforce, and Storage Intelligence[/b] - Evidence-based diagnosis of recurring operational problems. [*][b]Persistent Station Roles and Role-Aware Recommendations[/b] - Guidance based on each station's intended purpose. [*][b]Managed Trade Orders[/b] - Optional evidence-supported EOC trade offers under player authorization. [*][b]Shipping and Logistics Control[/b] - Register eligible ships, scan supported needs, and use approval-required or bounded automatic assignment. [*][b]Guided Diagnostics and Recovery[/b] - Supplier diagnostics, stabilization findings, engineering probes, and recovery guidance. [*][b]Integrated Reports[/b] - Immediate reports in EOC plus permanent Logbook Tips copies. [*][b]Player-Controlled Automation[/b] - EOC acts only within authority explicitly granted by the player. [*][b]Personal Office Access[/b] - Adds an office-chair access button through UI Extensions and HUD without taking over other extensions' shortcuts. [/list]
[h2]Latest Release - EOC 2.2 GA[/h2]
EOC 2.2 GA adds named fleet-production templates entirely inside EOC, with owned-blueprint selection, bounded quantities, single-yard or distributed planning, Preview, and one deliberate Confirm action.
[list] [*][b]Fleet Build Manager[/b] - Create persistent named fleet templates entirely inside EOC, set bounded ship quantities, preview one-yard or distributed construction, and submit only after deliberate confirmation. [*][b]Owned Blueprint Search[/b] - Find ships by partial, case-insensitive ship name or hull/variant identifier while building a fleet template. [*][b]Distributed Player-Shipyard Construction[/b] - Spread a confirmed fleet across compatible owned yards while preserving normal blueprint, loadout, resource, captain, and crew requirements. [*]Adds internal EOC ship ordering for supported station logistics shortages without opening the vanilla shipyard configuration screen. [*]Offers Medium and Large logistics ships when valid owned blueprints and compatible player-owned shipyards are available for both sizes. [*]Offers only the valid available size when the player can build just Medium or just Large. [*]Keeps ship-size choice, Preview, and Confirm as separate deliberate actions. [*]Uses X4-generated native loadouts, normal player-shipyard resources, and the native captain and crew lifecycle. [*]Queues exactly one ship and locks the station-and-cargo need against duplicate hull-size orders. [*]Adds OPEN EXECUTIVE OPERATIONS CENTER to Dock Interactions while seated in the Personal Office chair. [*]Adds the read-only Empire KPI Center with empire health, ranked station attention, trends, and operational measures. [*]Adds an immediate 10-second initialization notice so players know when EOC will be ready after loading. [*]Adds Fleet and Logistics registration for suitable unassigned trade and mining ships through player-deliberate actions only. [*]Adds clear working, completion, and next-step feedback to operational buttons and prevents accidental repeat submissions while actions are running. [*]Refreshes registered and pending ship views without closing EOC. [*]Shows readable ship purpose and operational/availability state. [*]Names completed ship assignments and destinations, removes completed Pending rows, and keeps the final completion confirmation visible. [*]Improves settings feedback for Managed Trade, ship-assignment enablement, Approval Required, and Auto-Assign Registered. [*]Adds guided navigation and return paths across Overview, Stations, Cases, Diagnostics, Fleet and Logistics, and Reports. [*]Improves report generation feedback and prevents duplicate report submission. [*]Corrects executive counter formatting and replaces unsupported trend symbols with readable text. [*]Retains X4 8.x and 9.x compatibility and all bounded player-authority safeguards. [/list]
[h2]Getting Started[/h2]
Load your game and wait for the approximately 10-second EOC initialization notice. Open [b]Docking Interactions[/b] using the icon immediately to the right of Diplomacy, then select [b]OPEN EXECUTIVE OPERATIONS CENTER[/b] to open the full EOC management window directly. The EOC pinwheel remains available as a separate navigation and return layer.
EOC follows the cycle: [b]Observe - Diagnose - Recommend - Teach - Verify - Safely Execute when authorized[/b].
Removing EOC will not make an existing save dependent on the mod.
[h2]Credits[/h2]
Created by [b]RazorEQX[/b].
Special thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/XaosSpecter][b]Reuivn[/b][/url] for proposing the original lore-friendly EOC access through the Personal Office.
Thanks to [b]UPB[/b] for technical advice and permission to use approved ship-lifecycle concepts and code.
[h2]KPI Feedback Requested[/h2]
The Empire KPI Center is intended to become more useful through player experience. Please share which KPIs help you make decisions, which are unclear, and which important empire measures are missing.
[h2]Links[/h2]
GitHub - Source Code and User Manual: https://github.com/razoreqx1/JK-Empire-Operations
Discord - Support and Community: https://discord.gg/qp8pmuWqtt
If you've been enjoying EOC, consider marking it as a Favorite on the Workshop. It helps other X4 players discover the project and keeps development moving forward. I've never asked for donations, locked features behind paywalls, or hidden the source. EOC has always been about giving something back to a community that's given me thousands of hours of enjoyment. It's the mod I've always wanted to exist in X4, and I'm building it so everyone can benefit from it. The only thing I ask in return is a Favorite if you think EOC has earned it. That one click helps more players find the mod and enjoy what we've built together. Thank you for the support.
